findings.description: Both runs return `HTTP/1.1 400 Bad Request`, `Content-Length: 0`, `Connection: close` at 2.00 s. The status is generic, so the client cannot tell an expectation mismatch from a malformed request.
findings.title: A waiting client is answered with a bare `400` after 2 s
